method.verdict: finalVerdict is the verifier's where a decision exists, else the auditor's. disposition is the state after this lane's proposals: headline, tool-lane, merged or retired. cut marks a surviving case this lane proposes to remove.
method.leaves: primary lists every surviving case assigned to the leaf, kept cases first, then cut cases in restore-first order. kept + slots + waived equals target, plus one on a leaf whose note says 'One over target'.
method.waived: A waived slot is a target slot that needs no new case because a kept case's key facts already test the facet. Each names the covering case. Reinstate it as a slot if the orchestrator disagrees.
method.behavior: A behavior-purpose case sits on a behavior leaf unless no behavior leaf fits and its key facts are world facts; those cases carry a relabel note.
